text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full-stack developer with 7 years of experience building and improving web applications.

I’d be glad to help with your custom WordPress site. While my recent work has been in JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, REST APIs, and Tailwind CSS, the core of this job is very familiar to me: finding what is slowing a site down, removing inefficient code paths, tightening queries, and making the application cleaner and faster to maintain.

A relevant example is my Home goods storefront rebuild for Juniper & Ash Home. I replaced a slow theme-based shop with a headless storefront and CMS that the marketing team could edit themselves. The result was a reduction in largest contentful paint from 4.1s to 1.3s. That project taught me how to identify bottlenecks, simplify the stack, and make performance gains without disrupting the business side of the site.

Another useful reference is my Booking platform for fitness studios for Pulsebox Studios. I built a white-label class booking app with subdomains, timetables, and memberships. It supported 64 studios onboarded in 6 months and achieved a 71% checkout conversion. That work required careful backend logic, database handling, and a strong focus on reliability under real usage.

For your WordPress application, I would approach this by auditing the slow pages, isolating bad PHP or database patterns, reviewing query behavior, and making targeted improvements where they will have the most impact. I’m comfortable working in a hands-on way and collaborating closely with a team on practical fixes rather than surface-level changes.

I’m also happy to work within your BitBucket and WP Pusher workflow and can adapt to an ongoing engagement if the site needs continued optimization after the initial performance pass.

If you’d like, I can help you get the site moving faster and make the codebase easier to support long term.
